summary: After a second endorsement fails, a member asks the group to revisit the first choice at a later head-to-head vote.
realLife: At the March meeting a member proposed revisiting the first assessor endorsement and holding a runoff; the subsequent motion to reconsider failed and the first endorsement stood.
inGame: needs: prior result and requested new contest.

turns.what: The secretary records that the earlier endorsement remains.
turns.writesBack: No runoff goes on the next agenda.

turns.what: The chair returns the earlier choice to the floor under the local rules.
turns.writesBack: A later runoff still needs a decision.
